Coaching Services

Base Coaching

Perfect for athletes wanting a solid foundation with customizable support and clear communication.

Base Coaching provides everything you need to build strong training habits and achieve measurable progress without the commitment of premium coaching. This program focuses on getting you training effectively with a custom program, regular feedback, and clear guidance to keep you moving forward.

Whether you're new to structured training or looking to refine your approach, Base Coaching offers a flexible, affordable way to access professional coaching.

Pricing

$400 per 8-week program

Professional coaching at an accessible price point.

What's Included in Base Coaching

Base Coaching gives you access to all core coaching features, designed to get you training effectively while remaining flexible and affordable.

📝 Custom 8-12 Week Periodized Program

A tailored program built around your goals, sport, and current fitness level. Includes clear exercise selection, progression schemes, and recovery periods to guide your training.

📹 Bi-Weekly Video Check-Ins (Monthly for Remote)

Regular 10-15 minute video calls to discuss your training, review progress, and address questions. Remote coaching options available with monthly check-ins.

🔄 3-4 Program Updates Per Cycle

Your program evolves with your progress. We'll adjust volume, intensity, and exercise selection based on your performance and recovery throughout the cycle.

📚 Exercise Library & Progressions

Access to our comprehensive exercise library with demo videos showing proper technique. Includes progressions for exercises at different levels.

📊 PR Tracking Support

Guidance on how to track and record your personal records effectively. We'll help you identify what metrics matter most for your goals.

📋 Training Log Templates

Structured templates to make logging your training easier and more consistent. Includes categories for notes, feelings, and any relevant observations.

Benefits of Base Coaching

💰 Cost-Effective

Access professional coaching at a price point that fits most budgets.

🎯 Clear Direction

Well-structured programming with clear guidance on what to do and how to progress.

🔄 Regular Feedback

Bi-weekly check-ins keep you accountable and ensure you're on track.

📈 Measurable Progress

Learn effective training principles and habits that will serve you for years.

How Base Coaching Works

The straightforward path to effective training with Base Coaching.

1

Complete Questionnaire

2

3

Custom Program Design

I'll design your personalized 8-12 week program with clear progression and exercise selection.

4

Bi-Weekly Check-Ins

Regular video calls to review progress, address questions, and discuss adjustments.

5

Progress Tracking

Monitor your PRs and performance, with program adjustments based on your progress.
